as_told.title: Ross Coulthart: buried UFO too big to move

plain: Somewhere at a sensitive site he will not name, there is said to be a UFO so big it could not be moved, so it was either buried or had something built on top of it. The journalist Ross Coulthart says this on two of Michels's episodes, passing on what his sources have told him. He says he stands by it, as he did when he first said it in conversation with Joe Rogan, and if true it would mean a craft was recovered and hidden right where it lay.
